_note: Story 31.3-001 recorded baseline — the qwen (local) arm's actual, real result. Not a scoreboard: every dispatch was blocked before a single ticket ran, so there is no per-ticket data to report. Recorded here, by category, per AC4 ('a harness that cannot complete the work is a finding, not missing data') rather than silently dropped from the comparison.
command_attempted: uv run sdlc eval --harness qwen --json --config eval/eval-config.yaml
stderr_verbatim: error: harness 'qwen' cannot take a model pin (config model='sonnet'); add a {model} placeholder and a 'models' map to its entry in the harness registry, or drop the harness override to run on the default claude harness
root_cause: controller/src/sdlc/config/harnesses.yaml's qwen entry has no {model} placeholder in its command template. sdlc.evaluate.resolve_eval_harness (AC6 of Story 31.1-001) refuses to run any registry harness silently ignoring the eval's pinned model, so the whole sweep aborts before ticket 1 rather than mis-report a model that never ran.

secondary_finding.description: Even bypassing the model-pin gate, the qwen CLI itself has no auth configured on this machine and refuses to run non-interactively.
secondary_finding.stderr_verbatim: No auth type is selected. Please configure an auth type (e.g. via settings or `--auth-type`) before running in non-interactive mode.
secondary_finding.note: This is a config/deployment gap (no local model server or DashScope credential wired up on this host), not a quality or latency finding — recorded because Story 31.3-001's technical notes anticipate exactly this: the local arm exposing an adapter-level failure before it exposes any quality difference.
